result:
I'd make it so that people could genuinely understand each other — not through some magic shortcut, but that the barriers to real understanding would lower. The distance between what someone means and what lands.

Not reading minds. Not forced empathy. Just that the friction between one person's inner world and another person's would ease. The way misunderstandings compound, harden, calcify into resentment, into walls that seem permanent...

Yeah. That.
